detail: Hit 3 times (SyncManagerTest, SettingsEpgPresetViewModelTest). Mockito sees the real arity including defaults. Update every stub to the full arity; never mix raw values with any().

summary: Locale parity tests pass on double-encoded translations (placeholders intact); 318 lines in 7 locales were garbage
detail: An agent wrote sv/th/tr/uk/vi/zh/zh-rTW strings through a single-byte encoding. Repaired byte for byte (encode with cp1252, decode UTF-8). SettingsStringsEncodingTest now fails on double-encoded text. Older line values-nb settings_auto_sync_explanation still holds a replacement character.

summary: Agent work written without a build had real defects: false reports, compile errors, a security hole and mojibake; every batch needed a compile and an independent review
detail: Examples: strings agent said it changed showUnexpectedError but did not; compareBy with a comparator needs two type arguments; W4 first fix rejected xtream:// URLs and widened an exported-activity attack surface. Never accept an agent's DONE without compile, tests and review.

summary: A scan launched with backgroundScope.launch on the standard dispatcher was cancelled before it stored its resume point; sibling tests use UnconfinedTestDispatcher
detail: Fixed by launching on UnconfinedTestDispatcher(testScheduler). Not a production bug.

summary: All six beIN Sport 1/2 EN channels return HTTP 503 on every probe while the account is idle and other channels play
detail: Provider-side; found by re-probing on 2026-11-09. A 503 was classified provider error, so earlier scans hid it. Scanner now stores repeated 5xx as EMPTY only when the provider looked healthy.
